nodes.label: Governance Gate
nodes.rationale: Default to separation unless identity is corroborated: exact ID match gives AUTO_MERGE, ID conflict forces KEEP_SEPARATE overriding semantic confidence, high semantic requires >=1 corroborating flag for REVIEW_REQUIRED otherwise KEEP_SEPARATE.

nodes.label: Deterministic Netting
nodes.rationale: Validated identities only; abstention equals exclusion so uncorroborated counterparties are excluded from netting runs.
